name: task-management
description: Backend-neutral task workflow skill with Hermes read, preflight, and approval-bound apply tools.

interface.longDescription: Provides Codex with a workflow skill for backend-neutral task drafting and review. Hermes registers task_query, task_preflight, and approval-bound task_apply. Provider mapping and MCP calls remain in separately installed adapter plugins; this package does not bundle an MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use task-management to turn this note into a reviewed task draft.
Use task-management to prepare a task routing preview.
Use task-management to check task backend boundaries.
